shortDescription: Fetch file content from a CoreFileObject node in Infrahub

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: Endpoint of the Infrahub API, optional env=INFRAHUB_ADDRESS

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch in which the request is made

options.name: dest
options.description: Local path to save the file content. When a directory path is given (trailing slash or existing directory), the file is saved as `{dest}/{node.file_name}`. When a file path is given, the file is saved exactly at that path. When omitted, file content is returned as variables only.

options.name: hfid
options.description: Human-friendly ID component values for the CoreFileObject node. One of I(node_id) or I(hfid) is required.

options.name: kind
options.description: Schema kind that inherits from CoreFileObject (e.g. C(NetworkCircuitContract))

options.name: node_id
options.description: UUID of the CoreFileObject node to fetch. One of I(node_id) or I(hfid) is required.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for Infrahub requests in seconds

options.name: token
options.description: The API token created through Infrahub, optional env=INFRAHUB_API_TOKEN

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL of the Infrahub instance
